stories.title: Free Money Meister Uses AI to Help Students Graduate with Less Debt
stories.summary: Free Money Meister uses AI to help students find scholarships and graduate with less debt. Founder Kiara Scott, who funded five years of education and graduated debt-free, created the platform to make her repeatable system accessible to all.
stories.extended_summary: Kiara Scott turned her personal success into a tool for others. After funding five years of higher education and graduating with $0 in student loan debt, she realized her method was a repeatable system, not luck. That's why she created Free Money Meister, an AI-powered platform that helps students find, prioritize, and apply for scholarships with less confusion. The platform replaces outdated databases with a personalized approach, guiding students toward funding options that fit their profiles. As a Black woman entrepreneur, Scott is also addressing financial and educational inequities, making the path to debt-free education clearer for everyone.

stories.title: How A Teenage Carpenter Became The Founder Of AI Construction Startup Trunk Tools
stories.summary: Sarah Buchner went from teenage carpenter to founder of a booming AI construction startup. After a tragedy on her site, she built tech that reads millions of pages of docs, saving time and lives.
stories.extended_summary: Sarah Buchner started swinging a hammer as a teenager in Austria, eventually running massive construction projects. But when a worker died on her watch, she walked away to build something safer. Now her startup, Trunk Tools, uses AI to digest the millions of pages of blueprints and contracts on every job site, catching costly mistakes before they happen. With 100+ employees and revenue up 4x, she's proving that the future of building is digital.
